description: This is a FastAPI router module implementing authentication endpoints, including user registration, login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh. It interacts with database repositories, uses Pydantic models for data validation, and incorporates password hashing for security.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest = Body(..., description="Registration payload"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation, password hashing, and creating a new user in the database, then returning minimal user info.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on email and password, returning a JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the current authorized user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile of the current user with provided data.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a new access token for the current user (mock implementation).
